profile.headline: software engineer/mobile apps engineer
profile.jobTitle: Freelance Senior Full-stack Software Engineer & Founder
profile.summary:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer & Founder building production systems across mobile, web, and backend. 16+ years architecting secure, scalable platforms for fintech, telecom, insurance, and SaaS.

Specialize in end-to-end product delivery: Flutter/Dart mobile apps, Next.js web platforms, Spring Boot microservices, real-time systems, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud). Hands-on with requirements through long-term scaling: testing, DevOps, database optimization, API design.

Founder of Loba Tech, a software consultancy; university lecturer in Computer Science since 2017. Mentor junior engineers on architecture, code quality, and emerging tools.

Driven by shipping reliable, maintainable systems and building strong teams.

positions.title: Freelance Senior Full-stack Software Engineer & Founder
positions.description:
Founder & principal engineer delivering full-stack solutions across mobile, web, and backend. Architect, build, and maintain production systems from requirements through deployment and scaling.

Core Focus:

• Mobile (iOS/Android): Flutter/Dart with BLoC, Clean Architecture, real-time sync (Supabase), push notifications. Camera/image processing, calendar integration, real-time collaboration, voice commands, biometric auth.

• Web & Backend: Next.js 15, React.js, Spring Boot, Node.js; REST/GraphQL APIs; PostgreSQL, MongoDB; AWS, Google Cloud, Vercel deployment.

• Real-Time Systems: Supabase (Auth, Realtime DB, RLS), Firebase, WebRTC for collaborative apps with role-based access control.

• Automation: Python pipelines, GitHub Actions CI/CD; Google Calendar, payment gateways (Stripe), document scanning, facial recognition, AI/LLM services (Anthropic API).

• UI/UX: Tailwind CSS, Figma design systems, mobile-first responsive design.

Domains: Fintech, Insurance, Healthcare, SaaS, Community platforms.

Leadership: Scrum Master & tech lead (2020–2021). University lecturer in Computer Science since 2017 (Java, OOP, data structures, mobile dev, Android, OS). Technical advisor on stack selection, code quality, emerging tools.

Tech Stack:
Mobile: Flutter · Dart · React Native
Web: Next.js 15 · React.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS
Backend: Spring Boot · Java · Node.js · Quarkus · Python
Databases: PostgreSQL · MongoDB · Redis · Firebase
Auth & Real-Time: Supabase · Firebase · Auth.js
Cloud: Docker · GitHub Actions · AWS · Google Cloud · Vercel
Integrations: Figma · GraphQL · REST · Stripe · Anthropic API

Case studies and references available upon request.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Software engineer: analysis, design, implementation, testing and integration of enterprise solutions, including Java EE back-­end, Spring framework, Mule ESB, Liferay, Vaadin, REST, Git, Maven, Jenkins, Eclipse, XCode, Amazon AWS. 

• Design and development of Android and iOS applications using Android API (Android Studio/Eclipse), and Objective­‐C (Xcode), respectively, including their design using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator. 

• Responsible for the installation, upkeep, configuration and reliable operation of Ubuntu Linux (virtual) servers, and monitoring of servers using Nagios.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Information Architect
positions.description:
Graduation project for the MSc. in Computer Science programme at the Delft University of Technology in The Netherlands. 

Topic: IMS Messaging Gateway in the Cloud using Java EE, JMeter, Open IMS Core IP Multimedia Subsystem, OpenNebula, VirtualBox, Amazon AWS, Amazon AutoScaling and Amazon CloudWatch.

positions.title: Computer Science Information Architecture Intern
positions.description:
Information Architecture Design Project carried out at the company INITI8 in The Netherlands as part of the Master of Science programme Computer Science track Information Architecture. 

Topic: Waiting time estimation to support allocation in the Dutch Youth Health care sector, using queueing theory, algorithm design, Java EE and MySQL.
positions.insights: Skills: Information Architecture · Agile · Data Structures · Web Technologies · Java · Analytical Skills · Software Engineering · Software Development · OOP · Web Applications

positions.description:
Graduation project for the Information & Communication Technology Bachelor programme at the University of the Netherlands Antilles in Curacao. 

Topic: ‘SMS­‐TV Application’ using Extreme programming methodology, C# .NET, Java EE, WSDL and MySQL.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Internship for the Information & Communication Technology Bachelor programme at the University of the Netherlands Antilles in Curacao.

Task: working with the software development team designing, developing, testing, and delivering software products using Java EE, XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
